label: git-tree-context-binding
command:
import json,pathlib,re,hashlib
base=pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/localos-git-history-verified-20260921.qZcoBF")
report=json.loads((base/"tree-blobs-redacted.json").read_text())
meta=json.loads(pathlib.Path(".agent/tasks/production-readiness-20260917/evidence/git-all-refs-tree-blobs-metadata-20260921.json").read_text())["findings"]
out=[]
for i,f in enumerate(report,1):
 b=(base/"tree-only-blobs"/pathlib.Path(f["File"]).name).read_bytes()
 lines=b.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
 source="\n".join(lines[max(0,f["StartLine"]-2):f["EndLine"]+1])
 parts=f["Match"].split("REDACTED")
 values=set()
 if len(parts)==2 and parts[0] and parts[1]:
  for m in re.finditer(re.escape(parts[0])+r"(.+?)"+re.escape(parts[1]),source,re.S):
   v=m.group(1)
   if "REDACTED" not in v and 0<len(v)<20000: values.add(v)
 shapes=[]
 for v in values:
  shapes.append({"length":len(v),"hex64":bool(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}",v)),"human_identifier":bool(re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9_-]+",v)),"whitespace":bool(re.search(r"\s",v)),"has_double_quote":'"' in v,"has_single_quote":"'" in v,"is_placeholder":bool(re.fullmatch(r"(?i)(redacted|<redacted>|test[-_]token|dummy[-_]key)",v))})
 out.append({"finding_id":i,"blob":pathlib.Path(f["File"]).name,"line":f["StartLine"],"end_line":f["EndLine"],"parts":len(parts),"prefix_length":len(parts[0]),"suffix_length":len(parts[-1]),"mapped_candidates":len(values),"candidate_shapes":shapes,"locations":meta[i-1].get("locations")})
print(json.dumps({"rows":out,"matched_rows":sum(x["mapped_candidates"]==1 for x in out),"values_withheld":True},indent=2))
